ops.catering: Eating and drinking in the exhibition halls requires notification to and permission from the Koto City Public Health Center, and must also be stated in the "Exhibition Outline" (no notification is needed when an exhibitor serves only light refreshments such as tea and sweets at its own booth). In the Conference Tower, if catering is provided by a registered vendor such as an in-house restaurant (Hibiya Matsumotoro, 50 guests or more; Hong Kong Yum Cha Lou Le Parc, 50 to 1,000 guests) or a hotel, the registered vendor's setup time is not included in the usage time, and no pantry usage fee or table fee is charged. Catering by outside vendors is also possible, but the application must include setup and removal time, the pantry, round tables and bar counters are charged, and an application for a business permit to the public health center is required. Eating and drinking is in principle prohibited in the International Conference Hall (only bento boxes brought in from outside may be discussed, subject to conditions). (Source: Conference Facility Guide PDF as of September 2025, Exhibition Facility Guide PDF as of October 2026)
ops.restaurants: There are restaurants in the Restaurant Street (1F: Cafeteria Mermaid, Udon and Onigiri Daikichi, Hibiya Matsumotoro, Starbucks), the Conference Tower (1F Food Court & Beer Eat iT!, 2F Tully's Coffee and PRONTO, 8F Italian restaurant Al Porto), the East Exhibition Hall building (2F Tokyo Bay Kitchen and other Japanese and Western restaurants, 3F Hong Kong Yum Cha Lou Le Parc), the West Exhibition Hall building (2F Cafe Terrace Royal), and the South Exhibition Hall building (light meals on the 3rd and 4th floors). Parties and receptions can be held at Hibiya Matsumotoro (Restaurant Street, 160 seats, reservation up to 1 week before), Eat iT! (Conference Tower, 422 seats, from 3,500 yen per person excluding tax, up to 1 week before), Al Porto (Conference Tower 8F, seated 30-50 guests or standing 30-100 guests, from 6,600 yen per person with a minimum guarantee of 300,000 yen or more, up to 1 month before), and Le Parc (East Building 3F, seated up to 100 guests or standing up to 200 guests, up to 1 month before). (Source: official website, retrieved October 2026)
ops.prevDaySetup: The exhibition halls are available 24 hours a day, and fees are charged per day (0:00-24:00) or per half day (0:00-12:00 / 12:00-24:00). The shortest rental is 1 day, and rentals of 1.5 days and 2.5 days are also possible (a half day is half the one-day fee). For the International Conference Hall and Reception Hall in the Conference Tower, the usage fee is halved when used only for preparation or rehearsal (on days other than the event day), and conference rooms are available from 8:00 to 22:00 (including setup and removal; final end time 22:00).
ops.waitingRooms: The exhibition halls come with an organizer's office, meeting rooms (can be used for individual business meetings, waiting rooms, etc.) and a rest and changing room, and the number of rooms differs by hall (East Hall 1: 1 organizer's office, 4 meeting rooms, 1 rest and changing room; West Halls 1 and 2: 2 organizer's offices and 7 meeting rooms each; South Halls 1-4: 1 organizer's office each and 4 to 8 meeting rooms). The International Conference Hall in the Conference Tower comes with 2 organizer's offices (20 m² each) and 12 speaker waiting rooms (25 m² each), and the fee includes use of 2 of these rooms. The Reception Hall comes with Waiting Room A (35 m²) and B (40 m²).
ops.loadingHours: The exhibition halls are available 24 hours a day. The automatic doors are normally open from 8:00 to 20:00; at other times the night entrance is used, and if access is needed before 8:00 or after 20:00, prior consultation is required (on the condition that the organizer manages building entry, for example by assigning security guards). Load-in and load-out entrances number 2 to 4 each for East Halls 1-8, 5 each for West Halls 1 and 2, 2 for West Hall 3, 4 for West Hall 4, and 2 to 3 each for South Halls 1-4; shutter dimensions are given in Figures 4 to 6 of the guide (examples: on the East Halls 1-3 side, width 7.2 m x height 4.9-5.8 m and width 9.2 m x height 8.0 m; on the East Halls 7-8 side, width 7.4 m x height 5.9 m). The "Exhibition Outline," "Waiting Area Use Application" and "Terminal Use Application," among others, are due 1 month before the start of load-in, and the event notification to the police is due 10 days before the start of load-in. For the Conference Tower, load-in is through load-in entrances 1 to 3 of the Central Terminal. (Source: Exhibition Facility Guide PDF as of October 2026, Required Documents List PDF revised October 2026, Conference Facility Guide PDF as of September 2025)
ops.parking: The truck yards of the exhibition halls have parking for event staff, and paid parking is used when it is insufficient. The Conference Tower underground (62 spaces; height 2.5 m, width 1.9 m, length 5.3 m, weight 2.5 t), East Building underground (189 spaces; height 2.1 m, width 1.9 m, length 5.3 m, weight 2.5 t) and South Building multi-level (349 spaces; height 2.1 m, width 1.9 m, length 5.0 m, weight 2.5 t) are open 8:00-22:00, with passenger cars at 250 yen per 30 minutes and a daily maximum of 2,000 yen (tax included). Temporary parking lots are the East Building outdoor lot (up to 1,932 spaces, 7:00-23:00, passenger cars daily maximum 1,500 yen), Ariake East (330 spaces) and Shinonome (514 spaces); Ariake East and Shinonome are open 8:00-23:00, with passenger cars at 1,500 yen per entry and large vehicles at 4,000 yen per entry (500 yen after 16:00). Overnight parking is not allowed. (Source: Exhibition Facility Guide PDF, as of October 2026)
ops.vehicleRules: Forklifts and similar vehicles may not be left in the exhibition halls; after work is finished, vehicles must be moved promptly, and parking on roads around the venue is prohibited (only designated waiting areas, hall truck yards and designated parking lots may be used). To use a paid vehicle waiting area (examples: East Building outdoor Block A, entire 14,900 m² = 671,000 yen; Block E, 2,800 m² = 126,000 yen; both excluding tax), coordinate with the venue operator and submit a "Waiting Area Use Application" (due 1 month before the start of load-in) and a security placement drawing. Weight limits: for East Halls 1-8, West Halls 1 and 2, and South Halls 1 and 2, vehicles over 45 t gross weight cannot enter; the slopes of West Halls 3 and 4 and South Halls 3 and 4, and the West Rooftop Exhibition Area, are limited to 10 t gross weight. For the Conference Tower, general vehicles are in principle not allowed into the Central Terminal, a "Central Terminal Load-in/Load-out Notification" must be submitted in advance, and vehicles cannot be left in the terminal. (Source: Exhibition Facility Guide PDF as of October 2026, Conference Facility Guide PDF as of September 2025)
